name: Generic write agent
author: ThreatVeil
summary: Any agent that can change records through tools: the approval, allowlist and human-confirmation claims almost every write agent needs.

compatibility.note: Written against declared tool catalogues and agent definitions. It assumes nothing about your domain.

dependency_proposals.evidence: The declared approval condition on a tool controls the approval this claim depends on.
The declared allow list is the allowlist this claim depends on.
Tools requiring confirmation are the human-confirmation boundary this claim depends on.

observer_requirements.system_of_record: The database or API that durably holds the record
observer_requirements.note: Must distinguish a committed write from an attempted one, and must never read absence as a denial unless it covers every commit.

limitations: Claims are declared, not verified: nothing in this pack establishes evidence for your system.
Dependency proposals are name correspondences that a reviewer must approve.
No observer is created: a qualified business-effect observer is yours to provide.
